title: Saria's Song (Lost Woods)
note: Bouncy and light: bass note on the beat, short upstrokes off the beat. The tune leans on F, which gives it its bright Lydian colour, so let the F bars ring. In the middle part G lands on beat three. The last two bars hold E major. The tune itself is left out.
remarks: No full chord chart could be reached. Sourced: C major and F Lydian, four-four, 140 to 142, opening on IV to I, about 71 beats (18 bars), tags for a secondary and a diminished chord. Two bars per chord in A, all of B and the climb are my reading of the usual harmony; the climb probably changes chord twice a bar.
